title: 第166章 故人安好行至龙州第165章 仙凡两隔难得故人
content_zh:
陈欣欣如今仅仅是金丹中期，难以在大赛之前突破到后期。
就是她突破到金丹后期，她一心思单纯的小女孩又如何能在那数万的的天骄中夺得魁首？
下一刻，狐歌看到了陈欣欣自信所在。
磅礴的灵力波动自其体内奔涌而出，这灵力仿佛天下灵力之初，气息极为强横且不带任何属性，但又可以转化为任意属性。
寻常灵力与之触之即散，更不说与之对抗。
这就是空灵根的恐怖之处吗！
随着灵力席卷全身，陈欣欣莲藕般的双臂骤然变为古铜色，在阳光的映衬下散发着金属的光泽。
下一刻，大力如断线风筝般瞬间倒飞出去，饶是以狐歌的眼力都没看清陈欣欣出手的身影。
大力痛苦嗯哼两声，双手颤抖着支撑起自己的身子，爬了起来，拍了拍身上的尘土。
浑身战栗不是因为害怕，而是兴奋！
“师尊！您也太强了！”
“在这魂宗之中有您保着俺，俺还修炼个屁啊，俺都想转行做花艺师了！”
“只需要天天帮师尊把花圃打理好就行了！”
陈欣欣轻叹一口气，无可奈何的看向一脸谄媚、溜须拍马的大力。
“那师尊要是日后飞升了呢？”
大力突然愣住，尴尬的摸了摸脑袋。
“也对！”
陈欣欣突然感觉到一股熟悉的气息，这股气息带着淡淡的泥土芬芳，令人心旷神怡。
“谁！”
恐怖的灵魂之力如无形的利剑一般直直的刺向狐歌的位置。

狐歌转生一世，灵魂力早已不再是其弱项。
但被灵魂之力锁定的一瞬间，头脑还是出现了一刻的空白。
狐歌强忍着剧烈的眩晕感，双翅猛的一振，如一颗炮弹一般，瞬间便扎入了土中。
朝着地底深处钻去。
陈欣欣玉足轻点地面，剧烈的震动使得她足底的大地龟裂出一寸宽的裂隙。
“哼！”
陈欣欣用尽全身力气，猛踩地面，尘土飞溅，形成淡淡的褐色尘雾。
无色的灵力化为青色，将褐色的尘雾驱散，露了一个半径十数米的大坑。
陈欣欣站在坑的中心，扫视四周。
“狐歌？”
陈欣欣贝齿轻咬下唇，眉毛因愤怒而翘成了对号，胸膛随着沉重的呼吸而不断的起伏。
这股气息除了茅不易和狐歌她从没在其他人身上感受到过。
而且，就算是金丹土修也不可能在她眼皮子底下瞬间钻入地底消失不见。
唯有狐歌所化的蜣螂，这等异虫才有如此本事。
但狐歌为什么要躲着我呢？
混沌灵根不弱于我，以他的天资，想必已经突破金丹了。
混蛋，骗了球球的金丹，还不敢见我！
陈欣欣冷哼一声，小女人般的跺起了脚。
大力从未见过师尊如此愤怒，像一头失控的暴龙一般，连洞府之前的花圃都被震了个粉碎。
零零碎碎的花瓣无力的从空中飘落，沉入泥土之中。

“师......师尊。”大力怯兮兮的看向陈欣欣。
陈欣欣无力的摆了摆手，缓步走向洞府之中，留给他一个落寞的白色背影，仿佛是夕阳下走丢的小羊。
“我靠，陈欣欣是怎么修炼的！”
“这么短的时间修为便超过了自己，这也太恐怖了吧！”
content_en:
Chen Xinxin is only in the middle stage of Golden Elixir now, and it is difficult to break through to the late stage before the competition.
Even if she breaks through to the late stage of Jindan, how can she, a simple-minded little girl, win the first place among the tens of thousands of geniuses?
The next moment, Hu Ge saw Chen Xinxin's confidence.
The majestic spiritual power surges out from his body. This spiritual power is like the beginning of spiritual power in the world. The aura is extremely powerful and has no attributes, but it can be transformed into any attribute.
Ordinary spiritual power would dissipate upon contact with it, let alone fight against it.
Is this the horror of ethereal roots!
As the spiritual power swept through her body, Chen Xinxin's lotus-like arms suddenly turned into a bronze color, exuding a metallic luster under the sunlight.
The next moment, Dali flew upside down like a kite with its string cut off. Even with Hu Ge's eyesight, Chen Xinxin's figure was not clearly visible.
Dali grunted in pain, supported his body with trembling hands, climbed up, and patted the dust off his body.
The whole body is trembling not because of fear, but because of excitement!
"Master! You are too strong!"
"You are here to protect me in this Soul Sect, but I am still practicing shit. I want to change my career to become a florist!"
"I just need to help Master take care of the flower garden every day!"
Chen Xinxin sighed softly and looked helplessly at the flattering and flattering Dali.
"Then what if Master ascends to heaven in the future?"
Dali was suddenly stunned and touched his head in embarrassment.
"That's right!"
Chen Xinxin suddenly felt a familiar breath, which had a light earthy fragrance, which was refreshing.
"Who!"
The terrifying soul power stabbed straight towards Hu Ge's position like an invisible sword.
Hu Ge was reincarnated, and his soul power was no longer his weakness.
But the moment he was locked by the power of the soul, his mind still went blank for a moment.
Hu Ge endured the severe dizziness and flapped his wings fiercely, like a cannonball, and instantly plunged into the soil.
Drilling deeper into the ground.
Chen Xinxin tapped her foot lightly on the ground, and the violent vibration caused an inch-wide crack to appear in the earth under her foot.
"Hmph!"
Chen Xinxin used all her strength to stomp on the ground, causing dust to fly and form a light brown dust mist.
The colorless spiritual power turned into cyan and dispersed the brown dust mist, revealing a large pit with a radius of more than ten meters.
Chen Xinxin stood in the center of the pit and glanced around.
"Fox song?"
Chen Xinxin bit her lower lip lightly, her eyebrows raised in anger, and her chest kept rising and falling with her heavy breathing.
She had never felt this aura from anyone except Mao Buyi and Hu Ge.
Moreover, even a golden elixir cultivator couldn't disappear into the ground instantly under her nose.
Only the dung beetles transformed by Fox Song have such abilities.
But why is Hu Ge avoiding me?
The Chaos Spiritual Root is not weaker than mine. With his talent, he must have broken through the golden elixir.
Bastard, Jin Dan, who deceived Qiuqiu, dare not see me!
Chen Xinxin snorted coldly and stamped her feet like a little woman.
Dali had never seen his master so angry before. Like an out-of-control tyrannosaurus, even the flower garden in front of the cave was shattered.
Fragmented petals fell feebly from the air and sank into the soil.
"Master...Master." Dali looked at Chen Xinxin timidly.
Chen Xinxin waved her hands feebly and walked slowly towards the cave, leaving him with a lonely white back, like a lost lamb in the sunset.
"Holy crap, how does Chen Xinxin practice!"
"It's too scary to surpass myself in cultivation in such a short period of time!"
